subject: Post-call: Audit logs & PII handling (FinCo Bank) - next steps
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@fincobank.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fincobank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Audit logs & PII handling (FinCo Bank) - next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Summary from call:
- FinCo is evaluating Redwood for customer-facing chat + user export features and needs:
  - Audit logs that show who accessed what and when (admin console, API requests, storage exports).
  - Exportable evidence for audits (ideally CSV/JSON/Parquet) that include user id, object id, action, timestamp, source IP, and request id.
  - Data retention & residency: requirement flagged for ~2 years of audit retention for regulated reporting; production data must remain in us-east region.
  - PII handling: redaction/pseudonymization for stored logs where possible; requirement for proof that sensitive fields are masked in exported artifacts.

Action items we agreed to: 
1) We'll provide a sample export (stripped of real customer data) showing the audit log columns and format.
2) Provide the SOC2 evidence outline and where audit artifacts live.
3) Confirm retention options and estimated cost/quote for 2-year retention on your account.

Timeline: target to deliver samples + SOC2 outline by EOD Mon (2026-03-09). Please confirm if that works for you.

Attachments: audit_log_sample.csv (sample schema), SOC2_evidence_outline.pdf (what we can provide).

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com

From: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@fincobank.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fincobank.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Audit logs & PII handling (FinCo Bank) - next steps

Alex — thanks for the recap, that aligns with our notes. A couple quick clarifications before you send samples: 

- For the "who accessed what" data, we need the export to include: user_id (internal), display_name (when available), timestamp (UTC), object_id (resource path), action (read/write/export/delete), source IP, request_id, and whether the action was performed via API or console.
- Export formats: CSV is fine, but we prefer NDJSON or Parquet for large sets. Can you include both CSV and NDJSON samples?
- Timeline: sample + SOC2 outline by Mon EOD is good. Our legal team will also want the docs; cc'ing legal@fincobank.com for routing.

Appreciate it — Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@fincobank.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Audit logs & PII handling (FinCo Bank) - sample exports and retention options

Hi Jordan — looping in technical details and what we can deliver out of the box. 

What the audit logs include (default columns): timestamp_utc, actor_type (user/admin/service), actor_id, actor_display_name, action, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, source_ip, user_agent, region, outcome (success/fail), dataset_id. We also capture any associated API payload ids where applicable.

Export formats we support: CSV, NDJSON, Parquet. Exports can be produced from the Console or via the Admin API. For large exports we provide a signed S3 URL (pre-signed GET) that you can fetch.

Retention options: Hosted accounts default to 90 days for high-volume request logs. For regulated customers we offer extended retention (90 days, 1 year, 2 years) on Redwood Dedicated or via a retention addon for hosted customers — this is configurable per-account and per-dataset. 2-year retention is supported but will require a retention plan amendment (we can include the cost estimate in the quote).

PII handling: We can provide pseudonymization/tokenization at ingest for specified fields and mark masked fields in exports. Note that raw request payloads containing PII are redacted in exported audit bundles unless explicitly requested and covered by a Data Processing Addendum.

Delivery timeline for requested artifacts: 
- Sample exports (CSV + NDJSON): 2 business days from request (I’ll produce sanitized samples).
- SOC2 evidence outline & where to retrieve artifacts: attached (SOC2_evidence_outline.pdf).

Attachments included: audit_log_sample.csv (sanitized), export_instructions.md (console/API steps), SOC2_evidence_outline.pdf.

Let us know if you need additional fields (e.g., tenant_id, customer_id mapping).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@fincobank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fincobank.com>, legal@fincobank.com
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Audit logs & PII handling (FinCo Bank) - sample exports and retention options

Marissa — this looks good. Two follow-ups from legal: 
1) Can you include a mapping of internal actor_id -> email (or a deterministic hash) in the sample so we can validate identity resolution in the logs?
2) Please attach the latest SOC2 Type II report or confirm when we can access it.

If you can include that mapping in the sanitized sample and the SOC2 doc, we can move to an internal review next week.

Thanks — Jordan

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@fincobank.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fincobank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Mar 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Audit logs & PII handling (FinCo Bank) - next steps and timeline

Jordan / Priya — quick update on next steps from Redwood: 
- Marissa will send sanitized sample exports (CSV + NDJSON) that include a deterministic hash column for actor_id -> email mapping by Mon EOD (2026-03-09).
- I'll attach SOC2 Type II report access link in the same package.
- I'll also follow up with a retention quote for 2-year audit log retention and any change to storage costs.

If anything else pops up for legal, please add it to the thread and we’ll include it in the package.

Best regards,
